NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>SOURCE is one near-frontal street photograph showing a tall right brick facade with four stacked window sections, a recessed central bay with two glass balconies, left dark vertical cladding, an elevated glazed pavilion, thin roof edges and brick boundary walls with metal gates. CURRENT preserves this overall arrangement, but simplifies defining facade relief and window divisions and misrepresents the visible entrance recess. Rear elevations, most side walls and roof-plan depths are unobserved; the additional CURRENT views cannot establish their fidelity. Screenshots alone do not verify concealed joints.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: SOURCE’s left facade has closely spaced vertical panel seams and a horizontal joint; CURRENT makes it a single smooth dark face. Both brick facade and boundary walls also lack the clearly visible brick courses.
action: Add the observed panel divisions and shallow relief locally, and apply correctly scaled brick coursing to the visible brick surfaces.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="front">problem: SOURCE’s entrance doors sit beneath a substantial dark recessed head zone. CURRENT raises the door heads almost to the main beam and surrounds them with a broad, exposed tan wall, weakening the entrance depth.
action: Lower the door heads relative to the beam and reproduce the recessed dark head and side returns. Ensure the doors and enclosing surfaces connect within the recess.</issue>
<issue priority="3" view="front">problem: CURRENT retains four stacked sections in the right window strip, but omits SOURCE’s visible vertical subdivisions, particularly in the upper two sections, and reduces its substantial dark framing to thin divisions.
action: Retain the four-section arrangement; add the source-visible vertical mullions and adjust frame and intermediate-band thicknesses locally.</issue>
<keep>Three upper glazed pavilion bays.
Two vertically stacked central glass balconies, with the lower balcony wider than the upper.
Thin projecting dark roof edge above the glazed pavilion.</keep>
